FINDINGS.title: Five different lead counts exist for the same twelve months, and nothing reconciles them
FINDINGS.evidence: Sep 2025–Aug 2026: L10 scorecard 73,193 leads; Respond.io conversations opened 73,069; Respond.io contacts added 69,483, of which 19,404 are CSV imports (net 50,079); platform-reported Sep–Jul 61,063 (Google Ads 26,756 fractional conversions + Meta 34,307 conversation starts); appointments booked Dec–Aug 3,094. No document in the set reconciles any two of these.
FINDINGS.impact: Every cost-per-lead, ROAS and channel-share figure in management use depends on which of the five counts was picked that month.

FINDINGS.title: GA4 key events were redefined twice in twenty months
FINDINGS.evidence: Session key-event rate 8–12% (Jan–Jun 2025) → 24% (Jul 2025) → 86–94% (Aug 2025–May 2026) → 54% (Jun 2026) → 10–12% (Jul–Aug 2026). Monthly key events 2,491 → 121,920 (Mar 2026) → 4,647 (Jul 2026). Named enquiry events (WhatsApp, Phone, Thank-you, Email, Carnival) sum to ~40k in 2025 against 342,076 key events. Admin key-event list could not be read (extension disconnected on Admin).
FINDINGS.impact: No year-on-year or month-on-month conversion comparison on the key-events metric is valid. The August audit's 52.6% all-time rate blends two definitions.

FINDINGS.title: Paid-ads leads book appointments at 1.5%; organic incoming leads at 14.4%
FINDINGS.evidence: Dec 2025–Aug 2026 lifecycle by source: Paid Ads 19,670 New Leads → 6,110 Warm → 667 Hot → 288 booked (1.46%). Incoming Message 16,883 → 11,173 → 3,981 → 2,428 booked (14.4%). Paid → Hot Prospect 3.4%. Meta CAPI workflows fire a Purchase event on lifecycle change (observed on a lead that later went Inactive), not on a booking.
FINDINGS.impact: The bulk of Meta spend from Dec 2025 is optimised towards a signal that does not represent a booking, and its leads are 10× less likely to book than unpaid ones.

FINDINGS.title: A third of the year's contacts were bulk-deleted; half the database has no stage
FINDINGS.evidence: 23,616 contacts deleted in Jul (14,018) and Aug (9,564) 2026 by the 'Help VISTA' account — 34% of the 12-month intake; 2 merges in 12 months. 44,300 of 95,031 contacts (47%) carry no lifecycle stage. 6,090 'Appointment Booked' contacts were created by a 21 Jan 2026 import; historic booked contacts were bulk-moved to 'cold leads' on 14 Apr 2026.
FINDINGS.impact: Historic funnel and conversion rates cannot be reconstructed, and 'Won' counts before Jan 2026 are not comparable with those after.
FINDINGS.source: Respond.io Contacts report · Deleted log · Contacts module

FINDINGS.title: Cost per booked appointment is RM182; the cost per lead in management use is ten to twenty times lower
FINDINGS.evidence: Total digital spend Jan–Aug 2026 against 3,065 appointments booked in Respond.io gives RM182 per booked appointment, steady from February to August (January higher while the Won stage was still ramping; Dec 2025 excluded because that stage was populated from 21 Jan 2026). The L10 'Revenue attribution' block multiplies hot leads by an assumed value per lead; Xedea Meta decks leave ROAS, Revenue and Sales blank every month; GA4 revenue is zero on every row.
FINDINGS.impact: The only number that ties marketing to a patient is ten to twenty times higher than the number budgets are set against.

FINDINGS.title: Google Ads 'conversions' are fractional all-action totals dominated by Performance Max
FINDINGS.evidence: PMax is 23–52% of reported conversions each month at a small fraction of the cost of a search conversion; Mar 2026 Carnival PMax alone added 3,302 conversions and pulled the headline cost per lead down by two thirds. Campaign tables fail to reconcile to the headline in 4 of 19 months (Jul 2026 gap: 1,079 conversions). A Jul 2025 step change in reported cost per lead is consistent with a conversion-action change; PMax cost per click fell by about three quarters.
FINDINGS.impact: Google cost per lead is not comparable across months and understates the cost of a real enquiry.

FINDINGS.title: Agency reporting is tool export without analysis
FINDINGS.evidence: 13 SEO reports are Semrush position-tracking exports: GA4 and GSC widgets carry no numbers, organic sessions and leads never appear, May 2026 report tracks a single day (7 Jun). 19 SEM reports are Looker exports with no commentary, targets, impression share or quality signals. Meta decks: Executive Summary ROAS / Revenue / Solution Seekers / Sales blank in every issue; no organic page metrics; 14 internal inconsistencies logged. Not one report mentions GA4 setup, Respond.io or the lead discrepancy the client raised repeatedly in L10.
FINDINGS.impact: The client has never received a written explanation of performance from its agency; the L10 issue list has carried 'Leads discrepancy — what's happening?' unresolved.

FINDINGS.title: Tracking fires without consent, double-loads GA4 and inflates form conversions
FINDINGS.evidence: vista.com.my: GA4 G-YKLZKC1WCE loaded hard-coded and again via GTM-PQ9TCR4 (two page_view hits); two Meta Pixels (760750721361681, 1655751015569796) and Google Ads AW-1071140050 hard-coded on every page including thank-you pages; Hotjar; no CMP or Consent Mode; no dataLayer events or conversion labels in source; WhatsApp 601155853937 links carry no UTMs. Thank-you pages are indexable and in the sitemap; 719 sessions landed directly on /thank-you* in 2025 with ~100% key-event rate.
FINDINGS.impact: PDPA consent requirement (RFP §19) is unmet on the live site; GA4 page_view and Meta PageView are over-counted; form conversions include refreshes and direct hits.

FINDINGS.title: Meta spend is invisible as Paid Social; UTM taxonomy has three parallel schemes
FINDINGS.evidence: Paid Social: 105 sessions in 20 months against a full year of Meta spend (Aug 2025–Jul 2026); Meta traffic lands in Cross-network (169,799 sessions), Organic Social (34,989, 2–11 s engagement, 99% 'engaged') and Referral (m.facebook.com). Custom mediums 'centers', 'center', 'fb', 'social', 'cny/2025' send 19,402 sessions to Unassigned. Campaign names use 1.1-General / 2.1-白内障 / 3.1-(BM) / 'XD -' / lowercase variants; Meta campaign IDs appear as utm_campaign. Ad campaign IDs reach Respond.io only in Sep 2025 and Apr–Aug 2026 (6,696 of 28,437 paid contacts).
FINDINGS.impact: Channel comparison in GA4 is a classification artefact; the Meta-vs-Google performance gap cannot be read from any current report.

FINDINGS.title: Data-centre and bot traffic is unfiltered and inflates engagement
FINDINGS.evidence: Cities with 0–5 s engagement and 90–99% key-event rates: Prineville, Fort Worth, Altoona, Ashburn (US), Dublin, Lulea, Lanzhou (99.77% key-event rate, 1 s), Forest City, Mumbai — roughly 15–20k users a year. '(not set)' browser/OS: 6,101 users in 2026 with 0 s engagement and 99% engagement rate. '(not set)' source/medium 563 sessions in 2025 at 27 events per session.
FINDINGS.impact: Engagement rate (92%) and key-event totals are overstated; no bot segment or filter exists.

FINDINGS.title: Sixteen branches, 101 location URLs, no H1 on any of them
FINDINGS.evidence: 74 duplicate, legacy or hub-copy location URLs return 200, self-canonicalise and sit in the sitemap (5 PJ-HQ copies in BM and 5 in ZH, 7 BM and 7 ZH hub copies, /locations-old/, 5 EN pages under the CJK slug /诊所地点/). 0 of 75 location pages carry an H1; none carries LocalBusiness schema; 9 of 16 EN branch pages have 78–109 words. Phone formats differ on 3 of 16 branch pages; enquiry form lists 14 of 16 branches; BM/ZH pages use retired branch names. GBP: 13 listings, ~7,150 reviews at ~4.8★, plus a duplicate HQ listing and keyword-stuffed names.
FINDINGS.impact: Local search authority is split across duplicates for the network's highest-intent queries ('eye specialist near me', 'ipoh eye specialist'). The /pages/ estate flagged in August now redirects (15/15 tested) — that finding is closed; this one replaces it.

FINDINGS.title: Sitemap omits every 2025–2026 post; no hreflang in HTML; Mandarin URLs percent-encoded
FINDINGS.evidence: vista.com.my Yoast sitemap lists 224 URLs; 52 live indexable posts (8 from 2025, 44 from 2026) are absent — only 2016–2024 press clippings are submitted. 0 hreflang link tags on 379 pages (sitemap only); languages served on ?lang= query strings; 37 of 43 Mandarin pages on percent-encoded slugs. vistanow.com.my: 156 BM/ZH pages canonicalise to the English URL; 31 of 39 ZH posts are untranslated English.
FINDINGS.impact: All content produced in the last two years is invisible to the sitemap, and the two non-English audiences (Mandarin 9%, Malay 6–10% of users) are served through a broken URL layer.

FINDINGS.title: Content output arrives in batches and has stopped
FINDINGS.evidence: Last 24 months: vista.com.my 55 posts, 24 of them in April 2026; vistanow.com.my 109 EN posts, 83 in Mar–May 2026 (presbyopia, amblyopia, dry-eye clusters). 0 posts on either site since May 2026; 15 of 24 months had zero output. At least 10 press-clipping posts duplicated across both domains. The RFP requires 4 medically reviewed articles a month.
FINDINGS.impact: Topical authority is built in spikes and decays between them; the content hub has no active link from the main site.

FINDINGS.title: The AI assistant handles 57% of conversations but cannot answer the question most leads ask
FINDINGS.evidence: VISTA Virtual Assistant assigned 46,447 of 12-month conversations; 4 human agents; 3 deleted agent accounts carried ~13,800 assignments. In 29 sampled conversations: every price or promo question ends in 'pricing not available here, please leave name and number' then auto-close as Inactive; 4 of 8 Instagram ad leads received the 'returning contact' menu instead of an answer; a booked patient adding a second person was answered with the welcome menu; a red-flag symptom case assigned to a human at 9:27 PM was unread at 11:45 PM; Meta page away-message fires before the AI reply.
FINDINGS.impact: The largest single lost-stage reason (Inactive Lead, ~40% of losses) is manufactured by the 8 h / 14 h auto-close after the bot fails to answer.

FINDINGS.title: Warm Lead remains the choke point and overall drop-off is rising
FINDINGS.evidence: Dec 2025–Aug 2026: Warm→Hot 21–33% every month; overall drop-off 65.5% (Dec) → 84.5% (Aug); average time to drop-off fell from 2 d 15 h to 10 h as auto-close tightened. Aug journey: New Lead drop 44% (Inactive 1,466, SPAM 439), Warm Lead drop 57% ('cold leads' 1,323 set by agents), Hot Prospect drop 31% ('Future Appointment' 124).
FINDINGS.impact: The August finding holds across nine months of data; the loss is a handling problem, not a media problem.

FINDINGS.title: Homepage is 3.08 MB, 151 requests, 7.3 s; HTML is never edge-cached
FINDINGS.evidence: TTFB 895–1,280 ms on every HTML document (cf-cache-status DYNAMIC, x-nitro-cache MISS, cache-control no-cache) despite Elementor Cloud + Cloudflare + NitroPack. 91–99 script tags and 36–46 stylesheets per page; reCAPTCHA Enterprise (347 KB) loaded twice because the form is embedded twice; observed mobile CLS 0.167. vistanow homepage 2.18 MB / 8.7 s / TTFB 1.4 s, no CDN. PageSpeed Insights API returned 429 (quota) — no Lighthouse or CrUX figures in this audit.
FINDINGS.impact: RFP acceptance requires Core Web Vitals 'Good' on mobile and Lighthouse ≥ 90; the current stack is structurally unable to reach it.

FINDINGS.title: 12–38 serious axe violations per page; 95.8% of images have empty alt
FINDINGS.evidence: axe-core 4.10.2 serious violations: home 22, LASIK 19, cataract 17, PJ location 12, doctors 12, vistanow home 38 (contrast, nameless icon links). No <main> landmark on any vista.com.my page; :focus{outline:none} on both sites; 83 focusable elements inside aria-hidden on the homepage; 17,650 of 18,419 img elements with alt="" including logo and doctor portraits.
FINDINGS.impact: WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA (RFP Scope 1 acceptance criterion) is not met on any tested template.

FINDINGS.title: No security headers; content hub exposes wp-login and xmlrpc
FINDINGS.evidence: vista.com.my: HSTS 180 days only; no CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options or Referrer-Policy; /readme.html exposed. vistanow.com.my: no HSTS, no security headers, /wp-login.php and /xmlrpc.php return 200, Elementor 3.13.1 / WPML 4.6.3 behind the main site. Both on WordPress 7.1. The August finding on plaintext credentials (F-06) was not re-tested.
FINDINGS.impact: Baseline hardening expected under RFP Scope 3 is absent on both domains.

FINDINGS.title: Structured data is Yoast default; 20 doctors share one page with no profile URLs
FINDINGS.evidence: Organization / WebPage / Breadcrumb / Article everywhere; Service on 6 pages, FAQPage on 4 (one duplicated), LocalBusiness on the EN homepage only. No MedicalOrganization, MedicalClinic, Physician or MedicalProcedure on either domain. 20 ophthalmologists listed on /doctors with no individual URLs, portraits with empty alt, one name rendered with Cyrillic characters. 176 of 379 pages without meta description, 131 without H1, 67 pages in 14 duplicate-title groups.
FINDINGS.impact: E-E-A-T and entity signals the RFP's AEO/GEO scope depends on (author, physician, procedure entities) do not exist in markup.

FINDINGS.title: Ranking counts are flattered by brand terms and a keyword-set expansion
FINDINGS.evidence: Semrush Top-3 count 59 (Jul 2025, 150 kw) → 87 (Aug 2025, set expanded to 201) → 106 (Apr 2026) → 97 (Jul 2026). 60–70 of the Top-3 terms each month are brand/navigational or near-zero volume. High-volume heads: 'eye specialist' (4,400/mo) 11→4–6; 'lasik surgery' (3,600) 5→1→21; 'cataract surgery' (3,600) 17→7→23→not in top 100; 'ipoh eye specialist' (2,900) 7→12. Organic sessions are not reported in any SEO report; GA4 shows Organic Search 121,135 sessions in 20 months at 52 s engagement — the best of any channel. vistanow index rate ~40% (Aug audit) unchanged in reporting.
FINDINGS.impact: The SEO KPI the client sees (Top-N count) can rise while commercial rankings fall.

FINDINGS.title: Social output is below the RFP minimum and engagement is thin; TikTok is the outlier
FINDINGS.evidence: Facebook 84K followers (7,357 reviews, 100% recommend); Instagram 21.3k, 994 posts; TikTok 14.2K followers / 44.7K likes; LinkedIn 689 (page slug vista-laser-eye-center); YouTube 45 subscribers. IG last 90 days: 32 posts (16 static, 10 reels, 6 carousels) — 0 posts 6–23 Aug, 18 posts 24 Aug–11 Sep. Last 20 IG posts average 29 likes (0.14% of followers) and 9 comments in total; FB posts 3–18 reactions, 0 comments; no page replies seen. FB and IG are identical cross-posts. TikTok pinned BM explainers 1.1M / 820K / 711K views; 16 BM videos in the last 4 weeks at 0.2–4.1K views. Xedea decks report no organic social metrics.
FINDINGS.impact: The channel with the largest audience (FB) has the lowest engagement; the channel with the best reach per post (TikTok) has no goal or budget line.

FINDINGS.title: Advertising-rule exposure across site, ads and social (flag only)
FINDINGS.evidence: 'Top #1' / 'Best #1' in 8 page titles; 'patients are guaranteed the highest level of service'; 'painless laser surgery'; '99% safety rate' (press clipping); 'most awarded'; Google Ads sitelinks 'The Best Eye Specialists', 'Award Winning'; Newsweek '#23 Refractive Eye Surgery' on the FB cover; public discount pricing on procedure and assessment offers; procedure-led promotions; 'EVO Toric ICL 2,000' milestone. KKLIU 0945 / EXP 31.12.2027 in the site footer; no KKLIU reference on 2026 social posts. No testimonials or before/after images found.
FINDINGS.impact: The RFP requires an approval trail evidencing medical and compliance sign-off; none of the observed claims carries one.
FINDINGS.source: Site crawl · Social profiles · Google SERP

FINDINGS.title: The L10 workbook carries formula errors, a copy error and an unbounded issue list
FINDINGS.evidence: #REF! in Carnival-Form and Total Leads (Mar 2023–Dec 2024) and CPL (2024). The ad-spend tab repeats October's Meta figure in November, against a different figure in the agency deck. Feb 2026 counts a 13,996-contact WhatsApp broadcast as leads, taking the month to 17,154 and cutting the reported cost per lead by two thirds. 190 to-dos and 169 issues with no dates or closure states. 2026 top-line lead goal, cost per lead and spend all blank in the yearly tab; VTO 1-year plan still dated 31 Dec 2025. The channel contribution-% rows behind August finding F-01 are not present in the shared export.
FINDINGS.impact: The one document the client manages performance from cannot be trusted below 2025 and has no closure discipline.

FINDINGS.title: Website attribution in Respond.io can never populate: there is no web-chat channel
FINDINGS.evidence: Channels in use: WhatsApp Business (53%), Messenger Main (42%), Instagram (4.5%), Messenger Kid and JB Mount Austin (<0.5%). No web-chat widget, Google Business Messages, Telegram or LINE channel exists, so Website / Page URL / Widget ID are attribution columns that no contact can carry. Calls is disabled. Settings, Channels, Users and Integrations are access-denied to the audit login. Reports allow 12 months of history; the Lifecycle report freezes on a 12-month range and shows stale numbers after a range change without reload.
FINDINGS.impact: Root cause of August finding F-08; website-originated WhatsApp leads are indistinguishable from any other WhatsApp contact.

FINDINGS.title: Broadcast imports enter the lead funnel as Warm Leads
FINDINGS.evidence: CSV imports: Oct 2025 3,300; Feb 2026 11,822; Mar 2026 984; Jul 2026 3,214 — matching WhatsApp broadcast campaigns (Durian Runtuh, per-branch Carnival 2026, ipfrelocation). 35 broadcasts, 19,247 messages sent, 14.5% failed. Imported contacts sit in Warm Lead (21,590 total) and inflate stage counts; 'Marketing' lost-reason spikes after each broadcast.
FINDINGS.impact: Warm Lead and contacts-added figures are not comparable in import months.

FINDINGS.title: Unpaid enquiries are the appointment engine
FINDINGS.evidence: Incoming Message leads: 16,883 New Leads → 2,428 appointments (14.4%) Dec–Aug, 8.4× the paid rate. Organic Search: 121,135 sessions, 52 s average engagement, 94% engagement rate — the strongest of any channel over 20 months. Google Maps: ~7,150 reviews at ~4.8★ across 13 listings.
FINDINGS.impact: The channels that book patients are the ones with no owner, no target and no reporting.

FINDINGS.title: TikTok is the cheapest and highest-reach channel and has no plan
FINDINGS.evidence: TikTok evergreen cost per result more than halved through 2026 on a small monthly budget; three pinned BM explainers total 2.6M views; @vista.eye posts near-daily in BM. No 2026 goal or budget line in L10; no TikTok integration with Respond.io ('Tiktok. integrate to respondio' open in the to-do list).
FINDINGS.impact: A measured test at a fraction of Meta's cost per lead is available without new creative.

FINDINGS.title: Carnival is the only fully tagged funnel — and shows what tagging is worth
FINDINGS.evidence: /malaysia-truly-carnival: 40,664 sessions Jan–Aug 2026 at 93% key-event rate; Mar 2026 sessions 59,570 (57% Cross-network); L10 records '1,300 leads form submission with UTM, 200 WhatsApp'. Carnival form leads are excluded from the monthly lead total by design.
FINDINGS.impact: The mechanics (UTM discipline, dedicated landing page, form + WhatsApp split) transfer directly to evergreen service pages.

FINDINGS.title: Mandarin and Malay demand is real and structurally under-served
FINDINGS.evidence: GA4 language: Mandarin 9%, Malay 6–10%, Indonesian 2–4% of users. Google Ads runs full CN and BM campaign sets in three regions. TikTok output is 100% BM. On the website, 37 of 43 Mandarin pages sit on percent-encoded slugs and vistanow's ZH posts are 79% untranslated. Xedea notes ~20% of visitors browse in a non-English setting.
FINDINGS.impact: The rebuild can serve both segments on clean URLs with hreflang at no incremental content cost.

FINDINGS.title: An AI-referral baseline already exists before any GEO work
FINDINGS.evidence: GA4 'AI Assistant' channel: 282 sessions in 20 months, 7 in May 2026 → 134 in Aug 2026, 89–92% engagement rate; chatgpt.com appears under four different mediums. A first AI-visibility baseline can be taken in Week 1 with a fixed prompt library across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude, so the RFP's GEO KPI starts from a measured number.
FINDINGS.impact: The RFP's GEO KPI can be baselined on day one rather than day 30.
